title: I3L: Iterative Interactive Imitation Learning for Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.17748v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Policies trained offline from teleoperated demonstrations can degrade outside their training distribution. This gap is particularly acute in long-horizon whole-body mobile manipulation, where long horizons amplify compounding errors and coordinated arm, torso, and base motion makes exhaustive demonstration coverage impractical. We introduce I3L, an integrated hardware and learning system that combines whole-body correction with iterative policy refinement to address this last-mile reliability gap. Its low-cost, open-source JoyLo+ interface uses policy-tracking leader arms and touch-triggered takeover to enable coordinated corrections across the body parts, while iterative deployment and retraining allow operators to target failures of the updated policy. translated_title: I3L：面向全身移动操作的迭代式交互模仿学习
translated_abstract: 通过遥操作演示离线训练的策略在训练分布之外往往会出现性能退化。这一差距在长时程全身移动操作任务中尤为突出：长时程会放大累积误差，而手臂、躯干与底盘的协调运动又使得穷尽式的演示覆盖难以实现。我们提出I3L，一个将全身校正与迭代式策略改进相结合的软硬件一体化系统，以解决这“最后一英里”的可靠性差距。其低成本、开源的JoyLo+交互接口利用策略跟踪主动臂和触摸触发的接管机制，实现对全身各部位的协调校正；同时，迭代的部署与再训练使操作员能够针对更新后策略的失败点进行定向改进。我们在三种机器人本体以及八个仿真与现实世界任务上评估了I3L，其中包括四个长时程全身移动操作任务。受控仿真实验……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了I3L软硬件一体化系统，通过低成本全身校正接口与迭代式部署再训练，让操作员针对策略失败点持续改进，从而显著提升长时程全身移动操作策略的可靠性。
en_tdlr: I3L is an integrated hardware-and-learning system that combines low-cost whole-body corrections with iterative deployment and retraining, enabling operators to target policy failures and greatly improving the reliability of long-horizon whole-body mobile manipulation.
